artifact_hash_policy.policy: Every versioned artifact is verified with raw-byte SHA-256 unless the artifact's own contract entry explicitly declares hash_mode=canonical_lf_utf8_text (G0-EOL-HASH-PORTABILITY). Only source_manifest.json is declared canonical LF UTF-8 text: its verification hash is computed on CRLF-to-LF normalized bytes, so LF and CRLF worktrees verify the same controlled text. Binary ZIP, CSV members, JSONL records/splits, and derived JSON aggregates without an explicit declaration remain raw-byte verified; nothing is guessed from file extensions. Normalization is limited to replacing CRLF pairs with LF; invalid UTF-8, NUL bytes, or a bare CR fail closed, and any one-character semantic change changes the canonical digest and fails the gate. New canonical-text declarations require an explicit contract entry plus matching gate code.

human_review_gate.notes: human_review_input_ready is true once the input gate is satisfied. The four orthogonal gates are: human_review_input_ready (user can start review at 0/150), human_review_freeze_ready (150/150 adjudicated, annotation frozen), formal_gold_publication_ready (route + data + stage3 + freeze policy all re-locked, ready to declare formal Gold), final_experiment_ready (everything including Stage 3 is locked). The route v2 being reopened does NOT block the input gate; it DOES block formal_gold_publication_ready. Agents must not infer or import any human review decision; the user remains the sole owner of approved/reviewed/adjudicated state changes.

formal_gold_publication_gate.conservative_policy: If any of the above fields is missing or non-locked, OR the status is not in the allowed_publication_statuses whitelist, formal_gold_publication_ready MUST be false. The route v2 being reopened, official modality data not yet ingested, Stage 3 subset/violation Gold not yet locked, the freeze_policy still being in 'do not write formal input or Gold until ...' mode, or the publication status not exactly matching the whitelist each individually keep formal_gold_publication_ready false.
